source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 14 (PDF 12-24), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Human Urinary System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define excretion. Name the metabolic wastes removed by the urinary system.
(Excretion ki tareef karein. Urinary system ke nikale jane wale metabolic fuzlaat ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Excretion woh amal hai jis mein jandar metabolic fuzlaat kharij karta hai. In mein nitrogeni fuzlaat (maslan urea), zaid pani aur zaid namak shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: The metabolic wastes include nitrogenous wastes, extra water, and extra salts etc

blocks.prompt:
2 Write the three essential roles of the urinary system.
(Urinary system ke teen bunyadi kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Nitrogeni fuzlaat nikalna: urea chhaanna.
2. Osmoregulation: khoon mein pani aur namak ka tawazun.
3. pH aur ions: sodium, potassium aur hydrogen ions ka tawazun taa ke khoon thora basic (taqreeban pH 7.4) rahe.

book_ref.quote: The urinary system performs three essential roles simultaneously

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between ureter and urethra.
(Ureter aur urethra mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono urinary system ki nalyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Ureters transport urine from the kidney to the urinary bladder

rows: Do (har gurde se aik)
Aik
Taqreeban 25 cm; renal pelvis se shuru
Bladder se shuru
Peshab gurde se bladder tak
Peshab bladder se jism ke bahar

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the position of the kidneys in the body.
(Jism mein gurdon ki jagah bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Gurde pait ki cavity mein oopar, reerh ki haddi ke dono taraf, 12th thoracic aur 3rd lumbar vertebrae ke darmiyan hain. Liver ki wajah se daayan gurda thora neeche aur chhota hai. Oopri hisse 11th aur 12th pasliyan jazwi taur par bachati hain.

book_ref.quote: Due to the position of liver, the right kidney is slightly lower and smaller than the left one

blocks.prompt:
5 Write the structure and function of the urinary bladder.
(Urinary bladder ki banawat aur kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Urinary bladder khokhla, phailne wala muscular organ hai jo pelvic cavity mein hai. Dono ureters is mein khulte hain. Yeh peshab ka zakheera hai; is ke muscles sukerh kar peshab urethra se nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: It serves as urine reservoir

blocks.prompt:
6 What is the renal hilum? Which structures pass through it?
(Renal hilum kya hai? Is se kaun si banawatein guzarti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Renal hilum (hilus) gurde ki dabi taraf aik gehra hissa hai. Yahan renal artery dakhil aur renal vein aur ureter bahar nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: At this point, the renal artery enters the kidney and the renal vein and ureter leave

blocks.prompt:
7 What are renal pyramids and the renal pelvis?
(Renal pyramids aur renal pelvis kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Renal pyramids: cone numa banawatein jin par renal medulla mushtamil hai.
Renal pelvis: gurde ke beech keep numa banawat jahan peshab jama ho kar ureter se nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The renal pelvis is a funnel-shaped structure in the centre of kidney

blocks.prompt:
8 What is a nephron? Name its two main portions.
(Nephron kya hai? Is ke do bare hisson ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nephrons khurdbeeni nali numa banawatein hain (har gurde mein taqreeban das lakh) jo gurde ki functional units hain. Is ke do hisse hain: renal corpuscle aur renal tubule.

book_ref.quote: A nephron consists of two main portions i.e., a renal corpuscle and a renal tubule

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between glomerulus and Bowman's capsule.
(Glomerulus aur Bowman's capsule mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mil kar renal corpuscle banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Renal corpuscle consists of two associated structures

rows: Capillaries ka jaal
Piyala numa, dohri deewar wali thaili
Afferent renal arteriole se banta hai
Glomerulus ko gherta hai
Is ka zyada pressure wala khoon chhanta hai
Glomerular filtrate wusool karta hai

blocks.prompt:
10 Name the three portions of the renal tubule in order.
(Renal tubule ke teen hisson ke naam tarteeb se likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Proximal convoluted tubule: shuru ka hissa, bohat pechdar.
2. Loop of Henle: U numa hairpin mor, descending aur ascending limbs.
3. Distal convoluted tubule: dobara pechdar; collecting duct mein khulti hai.

book_ref.quote: It consists of three connected portions

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between cortical and juxtamedullary nephrons.
(Cortical aur juxtamedullary nephrons mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jagah ki bunyad par nephrons do qism ke hain.

book_ref.quote: Nephrons are categorized into two types based on their location within the kidney

rows: Aksariyat, taqreeban 85%
Baqi nephrons
Zyada tar renal cortex mein
Cortex mein gehre, medulla ke qareeb shuru
Nisbatan chhote loops of Henle
Lambe loops jo medulla mein gehre jate hain

blocks.prompt:
12 What are papillary ducts?
(Papillary ducts kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kai nephrons ki DCTs aik collecting duct mein khulti hain. Collecting ducts medulla se guzarte hue mil kar bari papillary ducts banati hain jo peshab renal pelvis mein dalti hain.

book_ref.quote: As these ducts descend through the medulla, they merge to form larger papillary ducts

blocks.prompt:
13 Trace the path of blood from the renal artery to the glomerulus.
(Renal artery se glomerulus tak khoon ka rasta bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Renal artery hilum se dakhil ho kar shakhon mein batti hai jin se afferent arterioles banti hain. Har afferent arteriole capillary bed yani glomerulus mein jati hai.

book_ref.quote: It divides into branches which give rise to afferent arterioles

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between peritubular capillaries and vasa recta.
(Peritubular capillaries aur vasa recta mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono efferent arteriole se nikalti hain.

book_ref.quote: In juxtamedullary nephrons, the efferent arterioles also give rise to vasa recta

rows: Efferent arteriole ki shakhein
Juxtamedullary nephrons ki efferent arterioles se
Proximal aur distal convoluted tubules ke gird ghana jaal
Loops of Henle ke mutawazi lambi seedhi capillaries
Renal cortex mein
Medulla mein

blocks.prompt:
15 How does blood leave the kidney?
(Khoon gurde se kaise nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maddon ke tabadle ke baad capillaries mil kar venules aur phir bari veins banati hain jo renal vein mein khulti hain. Renal vein hilum se nikal kar inferior vena cava mein khulti hai aur saaf khoon dil ko le jati hai.

book_ref.quote: After the exchange of materials, the capillaries converge to form venules

blocks.prompt:
16 Why are kidneys called highly vascularized organs?
(Gurdon ko highly vascularized organs kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh dil ke kul output ka taqreeban 20–25% lete hain; dil ke pump kiye khoon ka bara hissa chhanne ke liye in se guzarta hai.

book_ref.quote: The kidneys are highly vascularized organs

blocks.prompt:
17 Why is the blood in the glomerulus under high pressure?
(Glomerulus mein khoon zyada pressure mein kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai. Is wajah se glomerular capillaries mein khoon zyada pressure mein rehta hai jo filtration ko Bowman's capsule mein dhakelta hai.

book_ref.quote: the blood within the glomerular capillaries remains under relatively high pressure

blocks.prompt:
18 What is glomerular filtrate? Name its components and the substances that stay in blood.
(Glomerular filtrate kya hai? Is ke ajza aur khoon mein reh jane wali cheezein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Khoon ke maye hisse ka taqreeban panchwan hissa (20%) jo Bowman's capsule mein chhanta hai glomerular filtrate hai. Is mein pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur namak (Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻) hain. Plasma proteins (albumin, globulins) aur blood cells bare hain aur khoon mein reh jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This high-pressure in glomerulus forces water, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins, and various salts

blocks.prompt:
19 Define selective reabsorption. Where does most of it occur?
(Selective reabsorption ki tareef karein. Yeh zyada tar kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Selective reabsorption woh amal hai jis mein mufeed maddy renal tubule se wapas peritubular capillaries mein jate hain. Zyada tar reabsorption proximal convoluted tubule mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Selective reabsorption is the process by which useful materials are transported from renal tubule back into the peritubular capillaries

blocks.prompt:
20 Which substances are reabsorbed in the proximal convoluted tubule and by which methods?
(Proximal convoluted tubule mein kaun se maddy aur kin tareeqon se wapas jazb hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 75% pani osmosis se capillaries mein wapas jata hai. Glucose, amino acids aur namak (sodium, potassium, calcium) active transport se khoon mein wapas jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Glucose, amino acids, and salts (sodium, potassium, and calcium) are returned from proximal tubule to the blood by active transport

blocks.prompt:
21 What is tubular secretion? Name the substances secreted.
(Tubular secretion kya hai? Secrete hone wale maddon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Tubular secretion reabsorption ka ulat hai: tubule ke epithelial cells ird gird ke khoon se maddy le kar filtrate mein dalte hain. Maddy: hydrogen ions, ammonium, potassium ions aur toxins ya dawa ke baqiye (jaise penicillin).

book_ref.quote: Secreted substances include hydrogen ions, ammonium, potassium ions

blocks.prompt:
22 How do the kidneys help maintain blood pH?
(Gurde khoon ka pH barqarar rakhne mein kaise madad dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen ions ko filtrate mein secrete kar ke gurde khoon ka acid-base tawazun (pH) barqarar rakhte hain aur khoon thora basic (taqreeban pH 7.4) rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: the kidneys play role in maintaining the acid-base balance (pH) of the blood

blocks.prompt:
23 Describe the path of urine from the collecting ducts to the outside of the body.
(Collecting ducts se jism ke bahar tak peshab ka rasta bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Peshab collecting ducts se renal pelvis aur phir ureter mein jata hai jo bladder tak le jata hai. Bladder ke muscles sukerh kar peshab urethra se bahar nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: From the collecting ducts, urine flows through the renal pelvis into a ureter

blocks.prompt:
24 Name the factors that affect the volume of urine.
(Peshab ki miqdar par asar karne wale awamil likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Zyada pani ya mashroobat: zyada peshab.
2. Zyada namak: pani rukta hai, kam peshab.
3. Warzish: saans aur paseene se pani nikalta hai, kam peshab.
4. Garam mausam: zyada paseena, is liye kam aur garha peshab.

book_ref.quote: This amount is highly variable and depends on several factors

blocks.prompt:
25 Why are plasma proteins and blood cells absent from the glomerular filtrate?
(Glomerular filtrate mein plasma proteins aur blood cells kyun nahi hote?)
blocks.explanation: Plasma proteins (maslan albumin aur globulins) aur blood cells glomerulus ki capillaries ki deewaron se guzarne ke liye bohat bare hain, is liye khoon mein reh jate hain.

book_ref.quote: So, these structures remain in the blood

blocks.prompt:
26 Name the parts of the renal tubule where water is reabsorbed.
(Renal tubule ke un hisson ke naam likhein jahan pani wapas jazb hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Proximal convoluted tubule: taqreeban 75% pani, osmosis se.
2. Loop of Henle ka descending limb: mazeed pani.
3. Distal convoluted tubule: kuch pani.
4. Collecting duct: pani ke wapas jazb hone ki aakhri jagah.
(Ascending limb pani ke liye band hai.)

book_ref.quote: As the filtrate moves further, more water is reabsorbed in the descending limb of the loop of Henle

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is urine concentrated and small in volume in hot weather?
(Garam mausam mein peshab garha aur kam kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garam mausam mein jism paseene se zyada pani khota hai, is liye gurde pani bachate aur kam miqdar mein garha peshab banate hain.

book_ref.quote: In hot weather, the body loses more water through sweat

blocks.prompt:
28 What is the purpose of the counter-current mechanism?
(Counter-current mechanism ka maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh loop of Henle aur collecting duct ke ird gird fluid mein namak (NaCl) ki zyada miqdar banata aur qaim rakhta hai taa ke in se osmosis ke zariye pani wapas jazb ho sake.

book_ref.quote: It is done by counter-current mechanism

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between the descending and ascending limbs of the loop of Henle.
(Loop of Henle ke descending aur ascending limbs mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ki mukhtalif permeability namkeen medulla banati hai.

book_ref.quote: The ascending limb is impermeable to water but actively transports salts out of tubule.

Cortex ki taraf wapas aata hai

Pani ke liye band
Namak ke liye band
Namak (Na⁺, peeche Cl⁻) active taur par bahar

Ird gird ke fluid ka namak zyada rakhta hai

blocks.prompt:
30 When do kidneys excrete hypertonic and hypotonic urine?
(Gurde hypertonic aur hypotonic peshab kab kharij karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jab jism ko pani bachana ho (pani ki kami) to gurde hypertonic peshab, aur jab jism mein zyada pani ho to hypotonic peshab kharij karte hain. Yeh kaam ADH aur aldosterone mil kar chalate hain.

book_ref.quote: When there is much water in body, kidneys excrete a hypotonic urine

blocks.prompt:
31 Where is ADH produced and secreted? How is its need detected?
(ADH kahan banta aur kharij hota hai? Is ki zaroorat kaise mehsoos hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: ADH hypothalamus banata aur posterior pituitary kharij karta hai. Pani ki kami ya namkeen khane par khoon mein namak ki zyadti hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors mehsoos karte hain, aur hypothalamus posterior pituitary ko ADH chhorne ka ishara deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is produced by the hypothalamus and secreted by the posterior pituitary gland

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke posterior pituitary pyaas paida karta hai; asal mein pyaas hypothalamus khud (thirst centre) paida karta hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
32 What is diabetes insipidus? Why is it dangerous?
(Diabetes insipidus kya hai? Yeh khatarnak kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pituitary ke nuqsan se kafi ADH na bana sakne wala shakhs musalsal bohat zyada patla peshab kharij karta hai; yeh diabetes insipidus hai. Is mein shadeed pani ki kami aur bohat kam BP ka khatra hai.

book_ref.quote: Such a person is in danger of becoming severely dehydrated with very low blood pressure

blocks.prompt:
33 How does ADH raise blood pressure?
(ADH blood pressure kaise barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Pani wapas jazb karwa kar ADH khoon ki miqdar barhata hai jis se BP barhta hai.
2. ADH khoon ki naliyon ko tang bhi karta hai jis se BP mazeed barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: ADH increases the blood volume

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between ADH and aldosterone.
(ADH aur aldosterone mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono gurdon ke kaam control karne wale hormones hain.

book_ref.quote: It increases sodium ions reabsorption from the filtrate into the blood

Adrenal cortex banata hai

Collecting ducts ki deewaron par asar
DCT aur collecting duct ki deewaron par asar
Collecting ducts ko pani ke liye zyada khula karta hai

blocks.prompt:
35 What is hyperkalaemia? How does aldosterone prevent it?
(Hyperkalaemia kya hai? Aldosterone is se kaise bachata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hyperkalaemia mein khoon mein potassium bohat zyada ho jata hai jo dil ki khatarnak be-tarteeb dharkan kar sakta hai. Aldosterone potassium ions peshab mein nikalwa kar is se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: a condition in which the blood potassium levels become too high

blocks.prompt:
36 What happens to urine and blood pressure when the salt concentration of blood falls?
(Khoon mein namak ki miqdar kam hone par peshab aur blood pressure par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ADH band kar deta hai; collecting duct ki deewarein pani ke liye kam khuli, kam pani wapas aur patla peshab kharij hota hai. Natijatan khoon ki miqdar aur BP kam hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The walls of the collecting duct become less permeable to water

blocks.prompt:
37 Why does aldosterone also cause reabsorption of water?
(Aldosterone pani ko bhi wapas jazb kyun karwata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldosterone DCT aur collecting duct par sodium ions filtrate se khoon mein wapas karwata hai. Khoon mein sodium ki zyada miqdar ki wajah se pani bhi filtrate se khoon mein chala jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to higher concentration of sodium ions in blood, water also moves from filtrate into the blood

blocks.prompt:
38 Name four common disorders of the kidneys and urinary tract.
(Gurdon aur urinary tract ke chaar aam amraz ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Urinary tract infections
2. Gurde ki pathri
3. Kidney failure
4. Polycystic kidney disease

book_ref.quote: A variety of disorders can affect the structure and function of kidneys and urinary tract

blocks.prompt:
39 Write the cause and any four symptoms of a urinary tract infection.
(Urinary tract infection ki wajah aur koi chaar alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Wajah: aam taur par bacteria, zyada tar Escherichia coli, jo urethra se dakhil hote hain.
Alamaat: bar bar aur fori peshab ki hajat, peshab mein dard ya jalan, gadla ya tez boo wala peshab, pait ke nichle hisse mein dard, kabhi bukhar ya kapkapi.

book_ref.quote: The symptoms of a UTI include a frequent and urgent need to urinate

blocks.prompt:
40 How is a UTI treated?
(UTI ka ilaj kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antibiotics ka course bacteria ko marta hai. Zyada pani peena aur bar bar peshab karna bacteria nikalne aur alamaat kam karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Drinking plenty of water and urinating frequently can also help to flush out the bacteria

blocks.prompt:
41 What are kidney stones?
(Gurde ki pathri kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pathriyan sakht, crystal numa maadni maddy hain jo jur kar gurde ya urinary tract mein chhote kankar bana lete hain. Yeh gurdon mein reh sakti ya urinary tract se bahar nikal sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: Urinary stones are hard, crystalline mineral materials

blocks.prompt:
42 Differentiate between calcium oxalate stones and uric acid stones.
(Calcium oxalate aur uric acid ki pathri mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ki tadad, wajah aur peshab ke test mein farq hai.

book_ref.quote: 10% of patients may have stones of uric acid

Taqreeban 10% mareez

Hyperuricemia (khoon mein uric acid zyada) se
Peshab tezabi
Peshab musalsal tezabi

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between ECSWL and PNL.
(ECSWL aur PNL mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono lithotripsy (pathri torne) ke tareeqe hain.

book_ref.quote: Treatment of kidney stones usually involves lithotripsy i.e., breaking of stones

rows: Lithotripter jism ke bahar se shockwaves banata hai

blocks.prompt:
44 Define kidney failure and renal dialysis.
(Kidney failure aur renal dialysis ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kidney failure: woh haalat jis mein gurde khoon se fuzlaat chhaanne aur pani-namak ka tawazun rakhne ki salahiyat kho dete hain.
Renal dialysis: kidney failure ka ilaj jis mein masnooi tareeqon se khoon se fuzlaat chhaane jate hain (haemodialysis ya peritoneal dialysis).

book_ref.quote: Kidney/renal failure is a condition in which the kidneys lose their ability to filter wastes from the blood

blocks.prompt:
45 What is a dialyzer? What is dialysate?
(Dialyzer kya hai? Dialysate kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Dialyzer: haemodialysis ka aala, aik filter jis mein cellulose ki semipermeable membrane hoti hai.
Dialysate: dialyzer ka khas fluid jo membrane ke raste khoon se fuzlaat, pani aur namak kheenchta hai.

book_ref.quote: This equipment is a type of filter and contains a semipermeable membrane (made of cellulose)

blocks.prompt:
46 How are wastes removed in peritoneal dialysis?
(Peritoneal dialysis mein fuzlaat kaise nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 1.5 se 2 litre dialysate catheter se pait mein dal kar 4 se 6 ghante rakha jata hai. Peritoneum ki capillaries se fuzlaat aur zaid pani is mein aa jate hain; phir ise nikal kar phenk diya jata hai. Din mein kai bar dohraya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Waste products and excess fluid from the blood capillaries of peritoneum pass into the dialysate

blocks.prompt:
47 Write any four problems associated with dialysis.
(Dialysis ke koi chaar masail likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Khoon tak rasai se infection ka khatra.
2. Hypotension (kam BP), haemodialysis mein aam.
3. Namak ki tabdeeli se muscles ke cramps.
4. Anaemia, jis se thakan aur kamzori.
(Is ke ilawa jaldi zyada pani nikalne se pani ki kami aur jazbati dabao.)

book_ref.quote: Dialysis can cause anaemia, which can lead to fatigue and weakness

blocks.prompt:
48 What is kidney transplant? Who is it offered to?
(Kidney transplant kya hai? Yeh kis ko diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kidney transplant aik operation hai jis mein na-kaam gurda donor ke sehatmand gurde se badla jata hai. Yeh end-stage kidney failure walon ko diya jata hai aur is mein ehtiyat se jaanch, milan aur nigrani chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Kidney transplant is a surgical procedure in which a person's non-functioning kidney is replaced with a healthy kidney from a donor

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between a related and an unrelated kidney donor.
(Rishtedar aur ghair rishtedar kidney donor mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono zinda donors hain.

book_ref.quote: Unrelated donor: The donor cannot be genetically related to the recipient

rows: Recipient ka jeeni rishtedar
Recipient ka jeeni rishtedar nahi
Misal walidain, behan bhai ya aulad
Misal shareek-e-hayat, dost ya saathi mulazim
Behtareen donor ho sakta hai
Kam aam; blood group aur tissue type milne par kamyab

blocks.prompt:
50 What is a deceased donor? How are their kidneys matched?
(Deceased donor kya hai? Un ke gurde kaise milaye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat log maut ke baad aaza dene ke liye hospitals mein register hote hain; yeh deceased donors hain. In ke gurde blood group, tissue type aur immune system ki mutabiqat se recipients se milaye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Many people register with hospitals for donation of their organs after their death

blocks.prompt:
51 Why are kidney transplant recipients at higher risk of infections?
(Kidney transplant wale mareezon ko infection ka zyada khatra kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Organ rejection rokne ke liye recipients ko immunosuppressant dawayein di jati hain. Dabe hue immune system ki wajah se infection ka khatra zyada hota hai; yeh dawayein BP, wazan aur cancer ka khatra bhi barhati hain.

book_ref.quote: Patients with a suppressed immune system are at a higher risk of developing infections after a transplant
